samples.question: The five cards on the left are badges, each carrying two coloured pips. The five cards on the right are holders, each carrying three coloured pips; count the holders 1 to 5 from the top. A badge fits a holder only if both of the badge's colours appear on that holder, and the order of the pips means nothing. There is exactly one way to put all five badges into five different holders, one badge in each holder. One badge is marked by a black tag. Which holder does the tagged badge go into? Answer with exactly one of: holder-1, holder-2, holder-3, holder-4, holder-5.
